stories.title: Winless no more: Chargers hold off Ravens after forcing late fumble
stories.summary: The Chargers' defense stifles Baltimore's running backs, and Justin Herbert steps up in Los Angeles' first win.

stories.title: Chargers finally get their first win: 'Thrilled, let's do it every week'
stories.summary: The Chargers beat the Ravens 23-30 on Monday night to earn their first win since Week 16 of last season, bringing a franchise-wide sigh of relief.

stories.title: Hamilton says Ravens 'disgracing' standards after embarrassing loss to Chargers
stories.summary: Pro Bowl safety Kyle Hamilton vented after the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the previously winless Chargers on Monday night, which was one of the most embarrassing defeats in team history.

stories.title: Brown's mention of 'trust the process' delights Embiid after duo star in 76ers' win
stories.summary: Joel Embiid (37 points) and Jaylen Brown (31) both turned in season highs Monday night as the 76ers beat the Nets with LeBron James sidelined to improve to 12-3.

stories.title: Fulwiley not with team after arrest as LSU hosts Troy; Mulkey mum on status
stories.summary: LSU senior guard MiLaysia Fulwiley, who was arrested after allegedly attempting to flee a traffic stop, was not in the lineup or on the bench Monday night.
